title: Kya andhera
body:
Kya andhera
Haay
Aye phuphi amma - 3
Aye phuphi amma meri - 4
<<MINI>>
Kya andhera hai phuphi - 2
<<DIVIDER>>
Qaidkhane me sakina ka tha nauha aye phuphi
<<MINI>>
Kya andhera hai phuphi - 2
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek shama mangwaiye ke ho ujala aye phuphi
<<MINI>>
Kya andhera hai phuphi - 2
<<DIVIDER>>
1. God me apni chupalo dil dhadakta hai mera
Har ghadi lagta hai jaise shimr fir se aa gaya
Paas se mere nahi jaana khudara aye phuphi
2. Khauf aata hai phuphi din ke ujaale me yaha
<<DIVIDER>>
Wehshate hi wehshate hai qaidkhane me yaha
Ek pal lagta nahi hai dil hamara aye phuphi
3. Ab kaha baba ka seena chayn ki raate kaha
Ab kaha wo din rahe wo pyaar ki baate kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
Aayenge kab laut ke wo din dubara aye phuphi
4. Haa abhi kuch der pehle mujko neend aayi to thi
Chand lamho baad firse aankh meri khul gayi
Yu laga jaise ho baba ne pukara aye phuphi
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Aaye baba to sunau mai sitam ki daastaan
Mai dikhaaungi rasan ke aur tamacho ke nishan
Sun nahi paayenge baba haal saara aye phuphi
